drafts.subject: Re: Guest Post Proposal for jaseci.org
drafts.message:
Dear Jessica,

Thank you for reaching out with your proposal to contribute a guest post to jaseci.org. We appreciate your interest in collaborating and your offer of $150 per published post with one dofollow link included.

To provide a clear picture, our standard guest post rate aligns closely with your offer, and we do have specific guidelines to ensure content quality and relevance to our audience. I will send you our guest post guidelines document shortly for your review.

We are open to discussing a long-term partnership and would be interested to hear more about your content ideas and how you envision this collaboration evolving.

Please let me know if you have any specific topics in mind or if you would like to schedule a call to discuss further.

Looking forward to your response.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
